The formula for the derivative of the inverse is

$$
({f}^{-1})^{′}(x)=\frac{1}{{f}^{′}({f}^{-1}(x))}.
$$

Substituting $x=0,$ we have

$$
({f}^{-1})^{′}(0)=\frac{1}{{f}^{′}({f}^{-1}(0))}.
$$

From the table, we obtain ${f}^{-1}(0)=2$ and ${f}^{′}(2)=-8.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}({f}^{-1})^{′}(0) & =\frac{1}{{f}^{′}({f}^{-1}(0))} \\  & =\frac{1}{{f}^{′}(2)} \\  & =\frac{1}{(-8)} \\  & =-\frac{1}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
